verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 102.0 (+1.7% in a day) and momentum is 43: prices are falling. 84s cost 850, 85s 2,200 and 86s 4,000. It is Champions weekend, when meta cards usually sell best.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-10-16T12:35:00+01:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Capdevila 86 Base Hero after its 19% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 142,000 coins. Now 148,000. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 19.3% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 1 of 2 so far, averaging +5.0% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Buy Selma Bacha 86 after its 32% fall, sell in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 12,250 coins. Now 12,500. Buy the dip: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often recovers part of the fall within two days. Picked because it is down 31.9% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 0 of 2 so far, averaging -15.9% after tax. It sells and buys back, so the 5% tax is counted.

moves.title: Champions weekend: sell spare meta cards, keep the ones you play
moves.detail: Meta cards usually sell best during the weekend. Selling and rebuying cards you play costs the 5% tax and a higher weekend price.

moves.title: Fodder: 86s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 850 (1.02 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,200 (1.05 coins per Item Score point), 86s 4,000 (0.98 coins per Item Score point), 87s 5,900 (1.07 coins per Item Score point), 88s 9,900 (1.19 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 86s then 84s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Marc Bernal and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Marc Bernal 78 Rare -41.7%; Sydney Schertenleib 76 Rare -39.1%; Barbara Bonansea 82 Rare -36.8%; Hristo Stoichkov 89 Base Icon -30.6%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: Carlos Espí SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 42.4K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
